response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10
